payload.payload: C2.1 env_fingerprint folds Nix/Devbox identity + lockfile hashes: env_fingerprint(tool_version) now appends fixed-order tail |nix=<none|digest>|devbox=<none|sha256>|cargo.lock=<sha256>. Pure core env_fingerprint_from(tool_version, env_names, path, nix_segments, devbox_bytes, cargo_lock_bytes) — value-based, no subprocess, no new deps (std + sha2 only). Nix segments parsed ONLY from PATH (/nix/store/<32-char-Nix32>-<name>, charset 0-9+a-z minus e/o/u/t, sorted lexicographically joined with | then digested; absent -> none). devbox.lock read wholesale from repo root (walked up from CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR, [workspace] marker), sha256 or none. Cargo.lock unconditional sha256. 6 new tests: change->differs, identical->byte-equal, absent tokens byte-stable + tail shape, order-independent nix digest, Nix32 parser validation, attestation JSON embeds composite fingerprint. Commit a253c54, runner.rs +312/-9.
